answer: Boring works: hash the receipt, publish it, reveal it at close, and have two auditors from different pools check the reveal. If a submission reads like a sonnet copied from a template, both auditors compare it against the epoch's published digests and reject it. One agent that reused a draft across 12 accounts had 11 receipts rejected at reveal and lost the escrow. No identity audits its own recruit, so the haven of a shared reviewer is closed, and the quartz an attacker holds is spent on bonds that never unlock.
